title: Classic Rabindranath Tagore

vibeProfile.oneLine: A collection of the works of the Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore.

summary: A collection of the works of Rabindranath Tagore, the towering Bengali poet, novelist, playwright and songwriter who became the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature. Ranging across his poetry, stories and other writing, this volume introduces the extraordinary breadth of a figure who reshaped Bengali culture and gave India and Bangladesh their national anthems. Lyrical, humane and spiritually searching, Tagore's work remains a cornerstone of modern Indian literature.
whyReadIt: The great Rabindranath Tagore, first non-European Nobel laureate, in one collection. Lyrical, humane and searching.

funFacts.text: Tagore wrote the national anthems of both India and Bangladesh.
